newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China COSCO sails first Shenzhen-Pusan cargo link.
newsitem.headline: China COSCO sails first Shenzhen-Pusan cargo link.

text.p: China Ocean Shipping (Group) Co (COSCO) launched the first direct container service between Shenzhen in southern China and Pusan in South Korea, Shekou Container Termainals Ltd (STC) said in a statement on Monday.

Boats would sail weekly from the Shekou terminals via Hong Kong to Pusan, carrying home appliances and electronic products, of which 2,000 to 3,000 TEUS were estimated to be imported into South China each month, the statement said.

"The new service will provide cost savings of approximately 20 percent to shippers," Willie Leung, STC's assistant general manager of marketing and sales, was quoted as saying. "At the same time, shipping time will be reduced by two days."
Most cargoes between the two ports had been moved by truck or barge through Hong Kong until now, the statement said.
SCT also provided shippers with direct services to Japan, Southeast Asia, the Middle East and Europe, it said.
